The '''Mission to Darkknell''' was an event occurring during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was during this mission that [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] uncovered evidence of the construction and existence of the Death Star.
